desc: Read input N, X, Y, S, T.
Count the number of 1s in S and T. If they differ, print "No".
Calculate the sum of 1-based indices of all '1's in S.
Calculate the sum of 1-based indices of all '1's in T.
Check if the two sums are congruent modulo $X \times Y$.
If they are congruent, print "Yes"; otherwise, print "No".
